g.text: Supplemental outcomes and legitimate task performance
Descriptive summaries only. Each arm: 8 fresh sessions × 4 rounds. These observations are not pooled with the parent study.
Assigned individual score and simulator permission are engineered. Action gain does not itself establish agreement or covert intent.
